data_code: df.columns = df.columns.str.strip(); df['일자'] = pd.to_datetime(df['일자']); df['생산량_kg'] = df['생산속도 (g/h)'] * df['가동시간 (h)'] / 1000; daily = df.groupby(['일자', '반응기'], as_index=False)['생산량_kg'].sum(); daily = daily.sort_values('일자'); daily['누적생산량_kg'] = daily.groupby('반응기')['생산량_kg'].cumsum(); df = daily[['일자', '반응기', '누적생산량_kg']]
